abstract: In January 2022, I will have completed my 12th year as the Executive Director of SMPTE. It is with a mixture of sadness and excitement that I am announcing my decision to move on. This will be my final column as Executive Director. It has been a great pleasure and privilege to have spent this time at SMPTE.
